title: docs(skills): page-builder guide drops the retired page:header breadcrumb and names placedActions
body:

_Requested by **Irene** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01TJXtQ1tVD26ecLDZxFS67x?thread=cmsg_01TJXtQ1tVD26ecLDZxFS67x3SdUTPmEPW1XtHGkGWMokB)_

Fixes #30031

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

The maintainer waived the model-tier mandate for `skills/**` while that tier had no quota; this PR was developed below it.

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么:`skills/objectui/guides/page-builder.md` L100-101 的 `page:header` 标题行键表删掉已退役的 `breadcrumb`,并加上已上线的 `placedActions: true`,现为 (`title`, `subtitle`, `actions` or `placedActions: true`)。
- 为什么改:`PageHeaderProps.breadcrumb` 自 spec 17 起是 `retiredKey` 墓碑(ADR-0087 D2),props lint 拒绝手写的 `breadcrumb`;#30097 合入后 header 渲染器已读取 `placedActions`。
- 风险与回滚:一个文件改一行,token 3410/3411,不动上限、不付账;发布 `@objectstack/skills` patch;回滚即 revert。
- 先看:page-builder.md L101。
- 需要你做的:无;席位处理 ready 与合并队列。

## What changes

- `skills/objectui/guides/page-builder.md` L101: `` `breadcrumb`, `` is removed from the `page:header` title-row list, and `placedActions: true` is named as the alternative to `actions`. The sentence now reads "a title row (`title`, `subtitle`, `actions` or `placedActions: true`) that takes no `children`". The rest of the file is byte-identical to `main`.
- `.changeset/30031-page-builder-header-breadcrumb.md`: `'@objectstack/skills': patch` with `Clause-②: no` and `Metadata-protocol: none`, its prose naming `page-builder.md` only. No `skip-changeset` label: a `skills/**` diff ships in `@objectstack/skills` (pr-automation.yml route 1).

An earlier head of this PR also changed the `page:header` row in `skills/objectstack-ui/rules/pages.md` L46, which said `placedActions: true` was "not drawn yet". PR #30127 (#29951) landed that fix on `main` ("(all placed, read live)"). The merge of `main` into this branch took `main`'s line as is, so `pages.md` is no longer in this PR's diff.

Read off `main` at `9a53fc9f` (merged into the branch, no rebase):

- `PageHeaderProps` in `packages/spec/src/ui/component.zod.ts`: `breadcrumb` and `showStar` are `retiredKey` tombstones. Live keys: `title`, `subtitle`, `actions`, `placedActions`, `recordChrome`, `showCopyId`, `maxVisible`, `mobileMaxVisible`, `aria`.
- **`placedActions` is live.** #30097 (#29951) dropped the `[PLANNED — not yet rendered]` marker from its describe, which now reads "Draw every action of the page's object whose `locations` include `record_header` or `record_more`, read live from the object's metadata, in place of an authored `actions` list … Refused as `true` beside an authored `actions` list: keep one." The `page:header` renderer in `ui/packages/components/src/renderers/layout/containers.tsx` reads `placedActions` and draws the placed header actions. The `.refine` on `PageHeaderProps` refuses `placedActions: true` beside an authored `actions` list, so the guide spells the two as alternatives ("or"). The first head of this PR (`d93cef6e`) left `placedActions` out because the describe at its base still carried the PLANNED marker; that reason no longer holds on `main`.
- `recordChrome`, `showCopyId` and `maxVisible` shape the record chip and the overflow menu, not what the title row holds, so the guide's sentence does not name them.
- Sweep of `skills/objectui/**`: L101 was the only `breadcrumb`. `showStar` appears nowhere.

**Token ratchet.** `page-builder.md`: 13628 → 13639 bytes, 3410 tokens (ceiling 3411, headroom 1). No ceiling row moves, nothing was re-wrapped, and no payment is owed.

## Why

The guide taught a key the props lint refuses, so a page authored from it would fail validation, and it did not name `placedActions` after #30097 made the header draw it.

## Verification

Head `16145621`: on top of `0f1ccaec`, a merge of `origin/main` at `9a53fc9f` (`31fbfb98`, `pages.md` resolved to `main`'s line) and one commit scoping the changeset prose.

All ran after `pnpm install --frozen-lockfile` and a full `pnpm build` on the merged tree (exit 0), each under a 900 s timeout with its exit code captured before any pipe.
- All 44 exited 0, among them `check-skills-token-ratchet.mjs`, `check:skill-examples`, `check:skill-identifier-liveness`, `check:skill-frame-sync`, `check:doc-authoring`, `check:dts-closure`, `check:dual-build-cjs-loads` and `check-comment-mask-corpus.mjs`.
